data.input: Run the script and capture the output. If a deadlock error occurs, note the error message.

rawInput.command: python3 deadlock_sim.py > deadlock_output.txt 2>&1; echo "exit code: $?"; echo "----- captured output -----"; cat deadlock_output.txt
